summary: The proactive pass and its act turn fail closed in four more places the independent audit found, and the two eval suites stop passing quiet cases for the wrong reason.
details: A proactive reminder whose note the room's workspace can no longer reach is not fired and not reported as retired; it fails as a wiring gap.
A proactive reminder written before the Dreamer was switched off still fires or declines properly: the act turn's runner exists whenever a home room does.
A proactive pass that cannot read its own decision log refuses to run rather than deciding over a placeholder.
The decide suite counts a refused `remind` attempt on a quiet day as a false positive; the act suite reports a guard-refused send as an error, never as a healthy silence.
A workspace with no home room no longer costs a tool-registry build and an error line every morning.
The strikes line a pass reads says «decided to raise Nx» rather than «raised Nx»; a decline charges no strike.
limitations: A room that stops being the home room keeps firing already-written proactive reminders while its `proactive` flag stays on; clear the flag on the old room when moving one.
